description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 新增“公式识别”：选好区域后按 `Shift+F` 或点工具条上的“公式”（贴图上按 `Shift+F` 或右键“识别公式”，编辑窗口里点“公式”），把图里的公式转成 LaTeX，可以改，按 LaTeX、Markdown、Word 公式或 Typst 复制，也能导出成图片、PNG、SVG；识别模型约 115 MB，第一次用时下载，在本机识别（要 Win顺 0.50.0，更早的版本会提示先更新 Win顺）。截图和贴图的按键提示改用菜单的字号；贴图快捷键可以设成和“贴到屏幕”同一个键（#469）；选中的行和卡片更醒目（#474）；系统内存紧张时闲着不主动归还内存（#471）。权限不变。
notes.en: Formula recognition: `Shift+F` or Formula on the toolbar after selecting an area (`Shift+F` or 识别公式 on a pin, Formula in the editor) reads the formula as LaTeX to edit and copy as LaTeX, Markdown, a Word equation or Typst, or to export as a picture, PNG or SVG; the model, about 115 MB, is downloaded the first time and runs on this PC (WinShun 0.50.0; earlier versions are asked to update first). The key hints of captures and pins take a menu's type size; the 贴图 hotkey may be the 贴到屏幕 key (#469); selected rows and cards stand out more (#474); idle memory is kept while Windows is short of it (#471). Permissions unchanged.
